About me

TM

Hey, I'm Tanvi — a video editor who loves turning raw clips into stories with rhythm.

I got into editing because I could never watch a video without mentally re-cutting it. Now I get to do that for a living: trimming the boring parts, timing the cuts to the beat, and finding the one take that makes a whole sequence click.

Outside of editing, I'm usually shooting photos, scrolling for reference on TikTok, or overthinking a transition at 1am. This is where I keep the work I'm proudest of — send me a message if you want to make something together.
